changes.detail: A Popen result with an invalid PID is terminated and waited on within the bounded stop timeout before the start operation fails; an untracked process is not placed in the runtime handle map.

Host failure categories are classified and passed to the existing BoundedRefinementPolicy through a public composition function; dispatch, reassignment, approval, persistence, integration, and reconciliation remain outside this adapter.

worker.reason: The prior bounded Windows outbound transport failure remains unchanged; no duplicate live dispatch was issued.

scope_boundary: This evidence covers local deterministic Guardian/refinement behavior only. It does not establish OS Service or deployed Guardian recovery, Compression authentication, D9 official-runtime mutation, or a new Free Worker integration.
